<!--
  A list or figures beside a picture. Axes: layout (figures: four figures in two columns, proof: three figures
  and a featured review, steps: numbered steps, posts: the latest posts, topics: topic rows with counts,
  contact: contact buttons and support figures), mediaSide, tone. The actions follow every layout but contact.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { MediaExtras, MediaListLabels } from "./media-list.types";
  import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";
  import type { Step } from "./steps-list.types";
  import type { Post } from "./post-card.types";
  import type { Category } from "./category-nav.types";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
  import type { Review } from "./review-list.types";
  import type { LinkActions } from "./error-page.types";

  export type MediaListProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    badge?: string;
    extras: MediaExtras;
    labels: MediaListLabels;
    actions: LinkActions;
    layout?: "figures" | "proof" | "steps" | "posts" | "topics" | "contact";
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.svelte";
  import MediaContacts from "../components/media-contacts.svelte";
  import MediaFigures from "../components/media-figures.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import MediaPosts from "../components/media-posts.svelte";
  import MediaReview from "../components/media-review.svelte";
  import MediaSteps from "../components/media-steps.svelte";
  import MediaTopics from "../components/media-topics.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    badge = "",
    extras,
    labels,
    actions,
    layout = "figures",
    mediaSide = "end",
    tone = "default",
  }: MediaListProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  lead={lead}
  heading={{ badge }}
  tone={tone}
  layout="split"
  media={{ show: true, side: mediaSide }}
>
  {#if (((layout as string) === "figures") || ((layout as string) === "proof"))}
    <MediaFigures extras={extras} mode={(((layout as string) === "proof") ? "row" : "grid")} />
  {/if}
  {#if ((layout as string) === "proof")}
    <MediaReview extras={extras} labels={labels} />
  {/if}
  {#if ((layout as string) === "steps")}
    <MediaSteps extras={extras} labels={labels} />
  {/if}
  {#if ((layout as string) === "posts")}
    <MediaPosts extras={extras} labels={labels} />
  {/if}
  {#if ((layout as string) === "topics")}
    <MediaTopics extras={extras} labels={labels} />
  {/if}
  {#if ((layout as string) === "contact")}
    <MediaContacts extras={extras} labels={labels} />
  {/if}
  {#if ((layout as string) !== "contact")}
    <ActionGroup
      primary={actions.cta}
      primaryHref={actions.href}
      secondary={((actions.mode === "two") ? actions.secondary : undefined)}
      secondaryHref={actions.secondaryHref}
      align="start"
    />
  {/if}
  {#snippet aside()}
    <MediaFrame
      alt={title}
      ratio={((((layout as string) === "steps") || ((layout as string) === "topics")) ? "1/1" : "4/3")}
    />
  {/snippet}
</SectionFrame>
